title: Machine learning-based glucose prediction with use of continuous glucose and physical activity monitoring data: The Maastricht Study.
summary: Machine-learning on Maastricht CGM data predicts 15- and 60-minute glucose values; external type-1-diabetes transfer is a small proof-of-concept. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: 851 participants with CGM; random train/test split, 540 also with accelerometry, and six-person OhioT1DM transfer check. Reported CGM-only error-grid safety >99% at 15 min and >98% at 60 min in main data; type 1 external subset is very small.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
